steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: paint a small yellow ochre glow
steps.load: a very small amount on the brush
steps.motion: draw a small oblong circle and blend outward

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add a touch of dark sienna into the yellow ochre
steps.load: a tiny bit of dark sienna added
steps.motion: lay color around the first layer

steps.subject: other: background fill
steps.action: fill the canvas with a lavender color
steps.load: blue and crimson mixed into lavender on the brush
steps.motion: fill the canvas with color

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add a bright white glow in the center
steps.load: a little pure white on the brush
steps.motion: work outward from the lightest spot
steps.rule: a glow shows more when darker colors surround it

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: dab a small round sun with white
steps.load: white on a finger
steps.motion: dab a small circle

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: paint the back trees with a blue-crimson mix
steps.load: larger batch, more crimson than blue
steps.motion: shape layered trees across the back

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: paint trees on the other side with the brush corner
steps.load: carried over from the tree mix
steps.motion: push basic tree shapes
steps.rule: a darker color makes it look closer to you

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: thin liner trunks, sticks, and limbs
steps.load: paint thinner thinned to ink-like
steps.motion: pull thin lines for trunks and limbs
steps.where: in the trees and front area

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: wiggle a trunk on the other side
steps.load: same thin liner paint
steps.motion: wiggle the trunk so it is not straight
steps.rule: a wiggle gives the trunk character, not a telephone pole look

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: dab multicolor shapes for highlights
steps.load: pushed the brush to load color on the tip
steps.motion: dab small shapes with the corner

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add bright highlights where the light hits
steps.load: carried over from the highlight pile
steps.motion: put small bright dabs on the trees

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: layer bushes farthest first, then forward
steps.load: a little more indian yellow on the brush
steps.motion: tap bush shapes in layers
steps.where: low down in front of the trees

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: add a warm pink touch where the sun shines
steps.load: least touch of crimson added
steps.motion: touch in a warm spot
steps.where: lower area where the sun shines

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: lay pure white snow with the 2in brush
steps.load: pure white on the brush
steps.motion: touch and let it go, following shadows
steps.where: start of the snow in the middle
steps.rule: picking up some color makes it look like shadows

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: add a bush hanging out over the snow
steps.load: same brush
steps.motion: pull white across the bottom edge
steps.where: edge of the snow near the bush
steps.rule: creates a plane behind to give depth

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: tap trunks with the fan
steps.load: lots of the dark mix on the fan
steps.motion: tap downward for fuzzy sides
steps.where: a few tree spots across the front
steps.rule: tapping downward gives the fuzzy sides evergreens have

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: make drooping limbs with the oval brush
steps.load: loaded a lot of the dark mix
steps.motion: touch the side and push to shape hanging limbs
steps.rule: limbs droop like tired trees weighed down by snow

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: reach arms out from the tree with the oval brush
steps.load: same oval brush
steps.motion: push out arms toward the light
steps.where: top of the tree and sky area

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: touch a dead tree trunk with white and dark sienna
steps.load: tiny amount of dark sienna in the white
steps.motion: touch and pull a little
steps.where: a dead tree near the snow

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: lit trees with white and warm colors thinned with liquid clear
steps.load: dipped in liquid clear, roll of paint on the edge
steps.motion: push to create lit trees

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add cool highlights on the tree, darker toward base
steps.load: same lit mix with a touch of phthalo blue
steps.motion: paint highlights and go darker toward base
steps.rule: a touch of blue cools it without making green snow

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: pull white at the base to pick up dark shadows
steps.load: white brush that picks up the dark
steps.motion: pull the bottom down

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: pull a clean fan through the base for small bushes
steps.load: clean dry fan brush
steps.motion: pull through the wet paint at the base

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: dab darker bushes at the tree base
steps.load: dark mix, not too dark
steps.motion: dab a few bush shapes

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add lighter highlights in the bushes
steps.load: lighter pile mixed on the brush
steps.motion: dab with the corner

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: pull titanium white lines for planes
steps.load: clean white on the brush
steps.motion: pull through to make planes
steps.rule: each pull creates another plane or level in the painting

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: drop in a big tree with brown
steps.load: browns mixed on the brush
steps.motion: drop in a big tree shape
steps.where: a big tree in the middle

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint thin limbs on the big tree
steps.load: paint thinner thinned brown
steps.motion: indicate a few limbs and twigs

rules: [04:58] round suns look better than square ones
[08:09] leaving light areas lets the sun seem to shine through
[13:57] leaving dark areas makes the tree look deep
[20:22] keep paint thick so thinner colors can go over it
